title: PULSE
summary: Cuts the sound on and off in a rhythm: a gate that pumps with the beat.
steps: Add PULSE to a pad, a bass or a lead.
Depth is how deep it cuts; Smooth makes the cuts softer.
Swing pushes every second step late.
